title: 第四章 暗中布局，初遇摄政王
content_zh:
送走沈敬山之后，屋子里总算清静下来。春桃麻利收拾桌上杯盏，一边收拾一边小声嘀咕，方才二小姐院里的丫鬟刚才在回廊四处嚼舌根，说嫡小姐心性狭隘，连亲妹妹的好意都全盘刁难。

    沈清鸢倚在窗边软榻，指尖无意识摩挲窗边雕花栏杆，听见这话只是淡淡勾了勾唇角。

    “随她们去说，口舌流言伤不到我分毫，反倒能早早让我看清府里谁的心偏在哪边。”

    前世她就是太在意旁人闲言碎语，被沈轻柔拿捏心理，屡屡自乱阵脚，最后落得满身污名。吃过一次炼狱之苦，她早已看淡这些无关紧要的闲话。

    落水之后身子仍虚，她吩咐春桃取来先前收在箱笼里的账本。那是生母柳氏在世时留下的铺面、田契明细，自打柳氏病逝，沈轻柔与其生母柳姨娘便借着打理家事的名头，暗中一点点侵吞生母嫁妆，数年下来，大半产业都悄无声息换了户主。

    前世直到临死前，她才偶然得知真相，彼时一切已成定局，想要追回早已无力回天。

    如今重回十五岁，一切都还来得及。

    沈清鸢铺开泛黄的纸册，一行行细细核对账目，越往下看，眼底寒意越重。不少城郊良田被以极低的价钱转卖给柳姨娘娘家，账目做得漏洞百出，只是往日她懵懂贪玩，从不过问家事，才任由对方肆意妄为。

    “春桃，你悄悄寻个靠谱的外院小厮，私下去城郊几处田庄暗访，记下佃户口中田地转手的细节，切记行事隐秘，不能惊动柳姨娘母女。”

    春桃连忙应声记下，知晓小姐是要慢慢拿回夫人遗留产业，眼底满是振奋。

    午后阳光渐渐柔和，沈清鸢想着出门透气，借着去城郊静安寺上香为由，向管家报备出府。一来避开府中柳姨娘暗中的监视，二来前世便是这几日，摄政王谢聿辞会途经静安寺附近处理一桩陈年旧案，两人的初次碰面就落在这条路上。

    谢聿辞手握朝野半数兵权，性情冷僻寡言，手握生杀大权，前世太子萧景渊处处忌惮此人，后来沈家蒙冤，全天下唯有摄政王曾暗中试图查探冤案，可惜那时为时已晚。
content_en:
After seeing Shen Jingshan off, the room finally became quiet. Chuntao quickly put away the cups on the table, muttering in a low voice as she did so. The maids in the second young lady's courtyard were gossiping around the corridor just now, saying that the first lady was narrow-minded and even made things difficult for her own sister's good intentions.

    Shen Qingyuan was leaning on the soft couch by the window, her fingertips unconsciously touching the carved railings by the window. When she heard these words, she just slightly curled her lips.

    "Let them talk. Rumors won't hurt me at all. On the contrary, they will let me see clearly who's heart is in the house early."

    In her previous life, she cared too much about other people's gossip, and was manipulated by Shen Qingrou. She repeatedly messed up her position, and ended up with a lot of stigma. Having suffered the pain of purgatory once, she had already looked down on these irrelevant gossips.

    She was still weak after falling into the water, so she ordered Chuntao to get the account book that she had kept in the cage. Those were the details of the shop and land deeds left by his biological mother, Mrs. Liu, when she was still alive. Since Mrs. Liu's death, Shen Qingrou and her biological mother, Aunt Liu, had secretly misappropriated their biological mother's dowry bit by bit in the name of taking care of the house. Over the past few years, most of the property had quietly changed owners.

    In her previous life, she didn't accidentally learn the truth until she was about to die. At that time, everything was a foregone conclusion and there was no way to recover it.

    Now that I am fifteen again, everything is still too late.

    Shen Qingyuan spread out the yellowed paper and checked the accounts line by line. The more he looked down, the colder his eyes became. A lot of farmland on the outskirts of the city was resold to Aunt Liu's family at very low prices, and the accounts were filled with loopholes. It was just that she was ignorant and playful in the past, and never paid attention to family affairs, so she allowed the other party to do whatever they wanted.

    "Chuntao, you quietly find a reliable servant in the outer courtyard, and go to several farmsteads in the suburbs privately to conduct unannounced visits. Write down the details of the land transfers in the tenant households. Remember to keep things secret and not alert Aunt Liu and her daughter."

    Chuntao quickly responded and took notes, knowing that the young lady was going to slowly get back the property left by her wife, her eyes were full of excitement.

    As the sunshine gradually softened in the afternoon, Shen Qingyuan wanted to go out for some fresh air, so she reported to the housekeeper to leave the house on the pretext of going to Jing'an Temple on the outskirts of the city to offer incense. Firstly, to avoid the secret surveillance of Aunt Liu in the mansion, and secondly, in the past few days, Prince Regent Xie Yu passed his farewell party near Jing'an Temple to deal with an old case, and the two met for the first time on this road.

    Xie Yuci held half of the military power in the government and the public. He was aloof and taciturn, and held the power of life and death. In his previous life, the prince Xiao Jingyuan was always afraid of this person. Later, the Shen family was wronged. The regent was the only one in the world who secretly tried to investigate the injustice. Unfortunately, it was too late by then.
title_en: Chapter 4: Secret plan, meeting the regent for the first time
